newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech June industrial sales rise 11.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech June industrial sales rise 11.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech real industrial sales rose 11.2 percent year-on-year on June after falling 0.7 percent year-on-year in May, preliminary figures from the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) showed on Tuesday.
The CSU added in a statement that nominal industrial wages were 16.0 percent higher, year-on-year, in June.
NOTE: The CSU noted that the impact of heavy flooding in July, affecting around one third of the Czech Republic, could not have influenced the June figures.
